WITH RECURSIVE pool_tree AS ( SELECT p.id ,p.parent_id ,p.pool_name ,p.hs_pool_name ,CAST(p.pool_name AS CHAR(2000)) AS poolFullName FROM ip_investment_pool p WHERE p.is_deleted = 0 AND p.parent_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT child.id ,child.parent_id ,child.pool_name ,child.hs_pool_name ,CONCAT(parent.poolFullName, '/', child.pool_name) AS poolFullName FROM ip_investment_pool child INNER JOIN pool_tree parent ON parent.id = child.parent_id WHERE child.is_deleted = 0 ) SELECT p.id AS poolId ,p.pool_name ,p.poolFullName ,p.hs_pool_name FROM pool_tree p WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ip_investment_pool child WHERE child.parent_id = p.id AND child.is_deleted = 0 )
AND p.id IN
#{poolId}
ORDER BY p.id ASC

SELECT export_row.securityShortName ,export_row.wind_code_sh ,export_row.wind_code_sz ,export_row.wind_code_nib ,export_row.wind_code_bj ,export_row.wind_code_nbc ,export_row.operationType FROM (
SELECT si.short_name AS securityShortName ,si.wind_code_sh ,si.wind_code_sz ,si.wind_code_nib ,si.wind_code_bj ,si.wind_code_nbc ,'' AS operationType FROM ip_pool_status ips INNER JOIN rrs_securityinfo si ON si.wind_code = ips.security_code INNER JOIN dict_security_type dst ON dst.security_type = ips.security_type AND dst.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ips.target_pool_id = #{poolId} AND ips.is_deleted = 0 AND ips.audit_status = '20' AND dst.category_type != 'company' AND ips.security_type != 'crmw'
AND (si.maturity_date IS NULL OR TRIM(si.maturity_date) = '' OR si.maturity_date >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-%d'))
UNION ALL
SELECT COALESCE(crmw_si.short_name, ips.crmw_name) AS securityShortName ,crmw_si.wind_code_sh ,crmw_si.wind_code_sz ,CASE WHEN crmw_si.wind_code_sh IS NULL AND crmw_si.wind_code_sz IS NULL AND crmw_si.wind_code_nib IS NULL AND crmw_si.wind_code_bj IS NULL AND crmw_si.wind_code_nbc IS NULL THEN ips.crmw_scode ELSE crmw_si.wind_code_nib END AS wind_code_nib ,crmw_si.wind_code_bj ,crmw_si.wind_code_nbc ,'' AS operationType FROM ip_pool_status_crmw ips LEFT JOIN rrs_securityinfo crmw_si ON crmw_si.wind_code = ips.crmw_scode WHERE ips.target_pool_id = #{poolId} AND ips.is_deleted = 0 AND ips.audit_status = '20' ) export_row ORDER BY export_row.securityShortName ASC

SELECT export_row.securityShortName ,export_row.wind_code_sh ,export_row.wind_code_sz ,export_row.wind_code_nib ,export_row.wind_code_bj ,export_row.wind_code_nbc ,export_row.operationType FROM (
SELECT COALESCE(si.short_name, al.security_short_name) AS securityShortName ,si.wind_code_sh ,si.wind_code_sz ,CASE WHEN si.wind_code_sh IS NULL AND si.wind_code_sz IS NULL AND si.wind_code_nib IS NULL AND si.wind_code_bj IS NULL AND si.wind_code_nbc IS NULL THEN al.security_code ELSE si.wind_code_nib END AS wind_code_nib ,si.wind_code_bj ,si.wind_code_nbc ,CASE WHEN al.adjust_mode = '调出' THEN '删除' ELSE '' END AS operationType FROM ip_adjust_log al LEFT JOIN rrs_securityinfo si ON si.wind_code = al.security_code INNER JOIN dict_security_type dst ON dst.security_type = al.security_type AND dst.is_deleted = 0 WHERE al.target_pool_id = #{poolId} AND al.is_deleted = 0 AND al.audit_status = '20' AND al.adjust_mode IN ('调入', '调出') AND al.audit_time > #{startTime} AND al.audit_time <= #{endTime} AND dst.category_type != 'company' AND al.security_type != 'crmw' UNION ALL
SELECT COALESCE(crmw_si.short_name, al.crmw_name) AS securityShortName ,crmw_si.wind_code_sh ,crmw_si.wind_code_sz ,CASE WHEN crmw_si.wind_code_sh IS NULL AND crmw_si.wind_code_sz IS NULL AND crmw_si.wind_code_nib IS NULL AND crmw_si.wind_code_bj IS NULL AND crmw_si.wind_code_nbc IS NULL THEN al.crmw_scode ELSE crmw_si.wind_code_nib END AS wind_code_nib ,crmw_si.wind_code_bj ,crmw_si.wind_code_nbc ,CASE WHEN al.adjust_mode = '调出' THEN '删除' ELSE '' END AS operationType FROM ip_adjust_log al LEFT JOIN rrs_securityinfo crmw_si ON crmw_si.wind_code = al.crmw_scode WHERE al.target_pool_id = #{poolId} AND al.is_deleted = 0 AND al.audit_status = '20' AND al.adjust_mode IN ('调入', '调出') AND al.audit_time > #{startTime} AND al.audit_time <= #{endTime} AND al.crmw_scode IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(al.crmw_scode) != '' ) export_row ORDER BY export_row.securityShortName ASC
